rules: 12 teams; auto: ACC/Big12/BigTen/SEC champs + highest-ranked G6 team; 7 at-large; straight seeding, top-4 byes; first round at higher seed; fixed bracket
committee_proxy: Starts in actual CFP Top 25 order; current committee residuals are retained while simulated final records change the ranking. Unranked teams start below No. 25.
engine: cfbseedR::cfb_simulations() v0.2.0 + current CFP ranking baseline
basis: Actual CFP rankings released 2026-11-03; completed results locked; remaining games simulated with the live football model

committee_anchor.method: Current CFP Top 25 order, with fixed committee residuals carried into simulated final records
